description: This file declares the IdentityNSPMDExpander class, which is a specialized SPMDExpander for the IdentityNOp operation within TensorFlow's DTensor MLIR framework. It includes method declarations for expanding operations and computing input/output layouts.
external_methods: StatusOr<llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>> ComputeLayoutForward(mlir::Operation* op, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>& input_layouts)

classes.name: IdentityNSPMDExpander
classes.description: A class that implements SPMD expansion logic for the IdentityN operation in TensorFlow's DTensor MLIR.

methods.name: ExpandOp
methods.description: Expands the given MLIR operation, implementing the SPMD expansion logic.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutForward
methods.description: Computes the input layouts based on the operation's semantics and output layouts for forward propagation.
